name: @builderforce/knowledge-graph-view
description: The ONE knowledge-graph view (PRD 38 §4.6, docs/specs/38-prd-knowledge-graph.md): a source-only React package — lens registry, deterministic 3D layout, instanced r3f scene, trace lanes, partition matrix, findings with Fix with agent, node panel, review progress and the list fallback. Pack-agnostic and host-agnostic: hosts supply a KnowledgeGraphSource and KnowledgeGraphLabels; the graph itself comes from @seanhogg/builderforce-memory/knowledge. Peers resolve from the host (the frontend's node_modules); this package installs nothing of its own.
